title: First Look Inside the Lucas Museum of Narrative Art
description:
A futuristic new icon is landing in Exposition Park: the Lucas Museum of Narrative Art. Founded by George Lucas, this long-awaited cultural landmark is the first of its kind, celebrating the unsung illustrators, comic artists, and visual storytellers whose imagination shapes our shared culture.

Designed like a sweeping, sci-fi-inspired vessel surrounded by lush hanging gardens and 11 acres of open parkland, the site fuses world-class visual art with a neighborhood-first sanctuary—creating LA's boldest new destination for inspiration and community.
